claims.text: LLMs face five major challenges when applied to fuzzing.
The five major challenges of LLM-assisted fuzzing are widespread across recent literature in top-tier conferences.
Actionable recommendations can address identified challenges in LLM-assisted fuzzing.

evidence.description: A literature survey of recent papers from top-tier conferences confirmed that the five identified challenges are widespread in LLM-assisted fuzzing.

methodologies.name: Literature review of top-tier conference papers
methodologies.description: Revisited recent publications from top-tier conferences to analyze and confirm widespread challenges in LLM-assisted fuzzing.

methodologies.name: Preliminary evaluation on DBMS fuzzing
methodologies.description: Applied actionable recommendations to LLM-assisted fuzzing in the domain of Database Management Systems (DBMS).

limitations.text: LLMs encounter fundamental challenges when integrated into fuzzing workflows.
Evaluation of the proposed actionable recommendations was preliminary and focused on DBMS fuzzing.
